RF-Scope APK build information
==============================

App name: RF-Scope
Package: com.rfscope.app
Version: 0.10.0 (versionCode 13)
Build type: debug (installable; Android Debug certificate)
Min SDK: 29 (Android 10)
Target/compile SDK: 34 (Android 14)
Built at: 2026-11-08 (Asia/Shanghai)

Size: 24929442 bytes

Changes in 0.10.0:
- Hardware page now prioritizes the TinySA spectrum view like the design preview.
- USB Host and antenna details move below the spectrum and collapse while connected.
- Header uses white RF-SCOPE title and cyan TinySA Ultra support subtitle.
- Spectrum trace uses absolute dBm color mapping, so noise is blue and strong signals become green/yellow/red.
- Spectrum trace is smoothed for a cleaner professional analyzer appearance.
- Waterfall noise is smoothed to reduce grain while retaining one row per scan.
- Compact spacing and hidden benign status messages keep the main screen focused.
- Includes all 0.9.3 connection, marker, tab, carrier, RBW, and scale fixes.

Notes:
- Debug certificate; not suitable for Play Store publishing.
- A new physical-device screenshot will be needed after installation to update the README.
